CO: TABOR limits GF appropriations; income tax largest revenue

KY: income tax cut 5%→4.5%(FY2023)→4%(FY2024)

OK: oil/gas gross production tax as separate revenue category

IA: income tax cut from graduated 8.53% → 3.8% flat by FY2026
NV: no income tax; gaming + Modified Business Tax (payroll) + sales tax
AR: income tax cut 5.9%→3.9% flat(FY2024)

KS: income tax 2-bracket 3.1%/5.58%
NM: Gross Receipts Tax (GRT) is NM's sales tax equivalent; large oil/gas revenue

HI: General Excise Tax replaces sales tax; Transient Accommodations Tax (tourism) significant
NH: no broad income/sales tax; Business Profits Tax + Meals & Rooms + I&D Tax (phasing out)
